needs.what: A towel to catch the water
needs.quote: Put a towel under the filter flap, since some water will run out.

steps.text: Unplug the machine from the socket.
steps.quote: Unplug the machine from the socket before you start.

warnings.text: Unplug it first; the camera checks the plug is out.

steps.text: Open the filter flap, bottom right.
steps.quote: Open the filter flap at the bottom right of the front panel.

warnings.text: Unplug it first; the camera checks the plug is out.

steps.text: Screw the filter back in until the arrows line up.
steps.quote: Screw the filter back in clockwise until the arrow marks line up.

warnings.text: Unplug it first; the camera checks the plug is out.
Do not open the casing. Behind the back panel is mains power.
